quote_filter_bounds: normalized V/K units; fwd = moneyness*exp(-q*T), disc = exp(-r*T); call midpoint must lie in [max(fwd - disc, 0), fwd], put midpoint in [max(disc - fwd, 0), disc]; inclusive, zero tolerance. Evaluated in float64 on the parquet AND on the float32-rounded values, so no row can flip sides in the export cast.
